name: SkillIconRecipeTable
description: 每个技能独立的图标生成配方；存在配方不代表已生成或已接入，开发美术提示不属于玩家文案。

fields.name: id
fields.description: 稳定配方 ID，约定为 10000 + skillId

fields.description: 此配方专属的战斗技能

fields.description: 单主体英文美术提示，至多一个简单动作或效果；仅供开发工具使用

rows.subject: A plain iron sword tilted upward with one broad curved slash mark.

A simple chunky wooden-stock rifle pointing diagonally upward with one short block-shaped muzzle mark. Use only a broad brown stock and one plain iron barrel; no scope, sights, screws, engravings or modern tactical parts.

A compact iron arming sword with a short plain grip, angled diagonally upward.

A short iron dagger tilted toward the left with one small solid orange curved slash mark. The slash is a single opaque flat shape with crisp filled edges; no white trail, glow, translucent edges or scattered pixels.

A simple white rabbit silhouette stretched into a leap above one broad curved motion arc.
A single open animal jaw symbol with two large cream fangs and a dark interior.
A small wooden fence section made of two chunky posts and one broad crossbar.

A compact wall panel made of exactly three chunky perfectly smooth flat brown rectangular planks and one broad horizontal cross brace. Only the two large seams between planks are visible. Each plank is a plain solid brown color with at most one side shadow. Absolutely no wood grain, knots, rings, streaks, interior lines, scratches, nail heads, holes, speckles or surface texture.
A single squat wooden step stool with one broad top and two short solid legs.
A simple raised wooden platform with a square top, tall thick supports, and one broad ladder rung.

A plain iron spade with one deep U-shaped brown cut beneath its blade.

A single raised clenched fist in warm red-brown solid blocks, with a strong square silhouette.
A single wide-open amber eye with one short thick alert ray above it.
A single purple crystal orb enclosed by one thick inward-curving violet band.
A plain wooden shield with one broad iron reinforcing band across its center.
A compact cream bandage roll with one large green cross-shaped patch on its wrapping.
A squat capped flask filled with muted steel-blue liquid, its body shaped like a simple shield.

A short plain iron sword falling sideways beside one large straight orange arrow pointing downward, clearly symbolizing a dropped weapon. Keep the sword nearly horizontal and the separate downward arrow thick. No curved slash, attack swoosh, impact, hand or ground.

A short broad pointed iron stabbing blade angled upward, with a plain straight guard and one large dark-red drop at its tip. The blade must be a thick readable shape at 32 pixels, not a thin needle. No basket guard, loops, wirework or decorative hilt.
A plain iron sword pointing upward with one broad upward lifting mark beside its grip.
A single plain tan clenched fist facing forward with a broad knuckle silhouette.
A single compact muted-green cloud with three large rounded lobes and a dark-green lower shadow.
A single broad blue water droplet with one short curved water band around its base.
A single green sprout with two broad leaves enclosed by one simple open circular renewal band.
A simple upright golden sword with a short broad crossguard and one muted-red upward chevron at its base.
A compact round orange fireball with one short flame-shaped tail and a plain yellow core.
A single blue water droplet stretched into a pointed dart with one short wave-shaped tail.
A single thick yellow lightning bolt with one broad blue water band crossing its lower half.
A single dark-red coal with one short upright orange flame.
A single orange ember core inside one bold four-pointed red burst shape.
A single pale-green branch with two broad leaves and one clean broken dark band falling away.
A single brass bullet passing through one small flat iron plate with a large simple split.

A simple chunky wooden-stock rifle with one curved firing trail containing two large brass blocks. Use only a broad brown stock and one plain iron barrel; no scope, sights, screws, engravings or modern tactical parts.
A single heavy dark-brass bullet with one short muted-red tapering trail.
A plain iron sword cutting through one broad violet ring broken into two halves.
A slim iron blade with one large dark-red drop curled toward its grip.
A single simple green thorn crown with one broad opening breaking its lower rim.

A broad medium slate-gray iron greatsword pointing downward with one separate solid dark-orange downward triangle beside its blade, symbolizing pressure. Use a thick solid gray blade and plain short straight guard, clearly readable on a dark background at 32 pixels. Both shapes float on transparency. No black blade interior, outline-only blade, engraving, ground, stone, dirt, rubble, debris, cracks, impact splashes or particles.

A wide iron greatsword with one broad fan-shaped ochre slash. The slash is a single opaque flat color wedge with crisp filled edges; no white trail, glow, translucent edges, ground, debris or scattered pixels.

A broad medium slate-gray iron greatsword with one compact muted-red candle-shaped flame at its tip. Use a solid clearly visible gray blade and plain hilt, with no black interior, engraved grooves or fine outline-only shapes. Both blade and flame must read clearly on a dark background at 32 pixels.

A massive solid medium-gray iron cleaver with a complete unbroken blade, beside one separate small square gray block emblem split by a single broad crack. The cleaver is intact; the crack belongs only to the square block symbol. No chipped blade, ground, rubble, flying fragments or fine cracks.
A single plain pale-blue iron bell with one thick angular frost band around its lower rim.
A broad iron blade with one thick dark-red curved stream returning toward its hilt.
A single wooden arrow wrapped in one thick pale loop of webbing; no fine web mesh.
A single white-fletched arrow splitting into two broad arrowheads in a simple fork.
A single wooden arrow with one large muted-green poison drop clinging to its head.
A single dark wooden arrow with one concentrated green drop drawn into its broad arrowhead.
A plain iron sword with one compact orange flame curling around its broad guard.

A heavy solid medium-gray iron greatsword pointing downward with one separate thick ochre zigzag fissure mark beneath its point. Keep the blade complete, plain and clearly visible on a dark background. The fissure is one simple flat symbol floating on transparency, not a ground surface. No black blade interior, engraving, dirt, stone, rubble, flying fragments or fine cracks.
A single pale-blue eye with one thick curved arrow-shaped tail wrapping around its outer edge.
A long plain wooden spear with a broad iron point and one short forward thrust mark.

A short broad solid medium-gray sword blade with its lower half covered by one opaque blue coating patch, beside one small squat blue reagent vial near the hilt. The blue coating is a plain filled shape hugging the blade. No pouring stream, glass reflections, tiny droplets, bubbles, labels or decoration.

A squat uncorked blue bottle tipped downward, pouring one broad solid blue water ribbon from its neck. Keep the bottle round and the water ribbon one compact opaque curved shape. No separate droplets, spray, foam, white trail, bubbles, labels or glass reflections.

A broad solid medium-gray shield with one oversized acid-green teardrop resting on its upper edge and one large simple green inset notch beneath the drop. Use the green drop and notch to express weakened protection. No skull, tiny bubbles, rust texture, shards, cracks, scratches or black outline-only shield.

A squat orange alchemist flask whose lower body merges into one broad solid burnt-orange burst silhouette, with one small bold yellow flame-shaped core inside the flask. Keep the neck short and the whole emblem compact. No floating fire, glass reflections, bubbles, thin rays, smoke, debris or separate sparks.

A single compact warm-ochre hand drum with one chunky drumstick touching its upper rim. The drum skin is one plain solid cream circle, and the drum body is one broad brown block. No musical staff, strings, rope lacing, grain, texture, text, sound rays or small details.

Two simple green ankle boots side by side pointing forward to the right, joined at their tops by one thick golden musical beam to form one compact marching rhythm emblem. Use broad boot silhouettes and one flat sole shadow each. No laces, stitching, tread, small notes, speed lines or texture.

A single large chunky muted-red musical eighth note split by one broad dark-violet zigzag gap through its round head and stem. Keep the note recognizable as two large fitted pieces with a clear broken silhouette. No extra notes, staff lines, tiny fragments, sound waves, glow or particles.

A single chunky golden musical note enclosed by one thick open teal circular arrow. Both the note and the return arrow are solid flat shapes, centered together as a compact emblem. No musical staff, thin lines, extra notes, tiny arrows, glow, sparkles or texture.

Two simple golden palms pressed together upright in prayer, with one thick turquoise open cleansing ring lifting away beneath the wrists. The hands are broad joined silhouettes with only one separation line. No fingernails, jewelry, finger creases, rays, glow, text, blood or particles.

A compact gold shield-shaped amulet with one small closed brown attachment loop directly above the shield and a single large flat green heart inset in its center. The loop must be fully visible, like a small ring, not a necklace cord. Keep the entire icon within the central 70 percent of the canvas with broad transparent margins on all four sides. Plain smooth shield face. No long cord, chain, cropped shapes, gems, engraving, filigree, reflections, glow or tiny decoration.

One large solid healing-green heart cradled by a simple ochre open palm. The wrist has one broad muted-red band to suggest the healer carrying a cost. Keep the hand and heart as two chunky clean silhouettes. No fingers drawn individually, veins, blood, extra hearts, rays, sparkle or texture.

One heavy golden judgment hammer angled downward with one broad solid violet downward wedge beneath its head. The hammer has a large plain rectangular head and a short thick handle. Both shapes are filled and clearly readable. No scales, text, engraving, glow, white trail, ground, cracks, debris or fragments.

A single thick violet chalk stylus tracing one broad unfinished square seal beneath its tip, showing preparation of a spell. Use only a chunky stylus and the open square stroke. No writing, letters, tiny runes or extra symbols.

One dark-violet diamond-shaped curse seal with four short blunt points and a large dark-red crack down its center. A compact solid stamped mark, not an ornate magic circle. No lettering, smoke, sparks or small runes.

One chunky dark-red heart with a single large violet bite-shaped cut eating into its right side, clearly showing life being eroded by a curse. Keep the remaining heart broad and solid. No face, veins, droplets, particles or gradients.

One large muted-green poison droplet centered inside a thick violet arrow pointing right, clearly showing poison being transferred away. The droplet and arrow form one compact symbol. No skull detail, extra droplets, cloud or background.

One broad solid-gray shield with a large wedge-shaped gap cut out of its right edge and one simple amber eye centered on the shield, suggesting an observed weakness. The eye is only two large color shapes. No metal reflections, rivets, cracks or fine markings.

A short broad solid-medium-gray sword held upright, with one thick orange right-angle arrow turning sharply away from the blade, showing a deceptive feint. Use a plain straight guard. No curved slash, white trail, thin outline-only blade or ornate hilt.

A short broad solid-medium-gray stabbing blade pointing right, with one thick blue arrow pointing left directly beneath its grip, showing a stab followed by retreat. Plain straight guard and a thick brown grip. No thin rapier, loops, pale motion streak or particles.

A short broad solid-medium-gray dagger entering the large open gap of one dark-red broken target ring, clearly striking an exposed opening. The ring has just one wide gap and no concentric lines. Plain straight guard. No neck anatomy, blood spray, thin blade or decorative hilt.

One close-up rounded dark-brown canine nose with a single thick muted-green scent ribbon curling toward it. Make the nose a bold triangular shape with only two large nostril blocks. No full animal, whiskers, fur texture or floating specks.

One broad tan animal pawprint with a thick orange arrow projecting to its right, clearly commanding an animal to move. Use one large pad and four large toe blocks. No claws, tracks, terrain, fur or repeated footprints.

Two large cream canine fangs facing inward around one small solid dark-red diamond target, forming one bold pincer-shaped animal-bite symbol. Keep both teeth thick and the central target easy to see. No full mouth, gums, fur, blood spray or decorative lines.

One simple tan canine muzzle gently holding a broad cream rescue cloth loop with one small solid green cross-shaped patch. A compact close-up symbol of an animal carrying an ally to safety. No visible teeth, fur texture, full animal, rope fibers or scenery.

One thick solid-medium-gray shield leaning right with a single broad orange arrow projecting straight from its right edge, clearly pushing forward. Use one gray base and one dark-gray shadow block. No wood grain, rivets, shine, impact debris or motion trails.

One chunky solid-medium-gray square hammer head with a short thick brown handle and one broad dark-red downward arrow directly beneath the head, showing a suppressing blow. No cracks, ground, debris, white streaks, shine or texture.

One short broad solid-gray arrowhead pointing right on a thick brown shaft, with a single thick tan rope loop attached at the rear and bending backward, showing a tethered pulling arrow. No bow, rope fibers, multiple coils, feathers or fine lines.

One simple chunky wooden bow aimed right, with one broad blue arrow pointing left below its grip, showing a shot followed by retreat. Thick solid bow limbs and a clearly visible thick taut string. No wood grain, arrow volley, white action trail or particles.

One short broad solid-medium-gray sword pointing upward with one compact orange flame hugging the lower blade, showing a weapon imbued with fire. Keep the blade visibly filled with medium gray and use a plain straight guard. No black hollow blade, thin outline, white streak, sparks or decorative hilt.
One broad blue water droplet split down the center by a single thick yellow zigzag lightning bolt. Use a compact solid droplet silhouette, no sparks, rings, stars or stun symbols.
One simple trip-rope assembly: two short chunky brown stakes joined by one taut thick tan rope. Isolated on transparency, with plain solid wood, no grain, ground, grass, knots or extra rope coils.
One compact bundle of three plain rectangular brown planks with one broad ochre return arrow curving back toward the bundle. Use flat untextured wood; no nails, tools, broken splinters or scenery.

One compact swap emblem made of two simple shield silhouettes, one muted blue and one ochre, connected by one broad opposing-arrow band. Keep both shields solid and plain; no people, faces, weapons or extra marks.

One broad solid medium-gray iron shield sheltering a small muted-green heart tucked partly behind its upper right edge. The shield is dominant and plain, with a simple blue center block; no person, text, ornament or projectiles.

One squat open reagent vial filled with muted-green poison, tilted to release a single large green drop. Use thick plain pale-blue glass edges and a solid green liquid block; no reflections, bubbles, label or tiny stopper.

One squat round alchemical flask with a solid green poison core, centered over one broad four-pointed ochre explosion shape. Keep the flask and burst as simple filled blocks; no fuse, smoke, splashes, fragments, sparks or glow.

One large dark-red blood droplet with one broad violet arrow curving from the droplet toward the right, clearly sending the drop outward. Keep a simple filled teardrop and a single readable arrow; no blade, hand, splatter or extra drops.

One large solid ochre downward chevron symbol for weakness, carried outward by one broad violet arrow curving to the right. Use two chunky unmistakable flat symbols; no weapon, person, lettering, repeated arrows or extra effects.

One plain broad solid medium-gray iron sword with a single thick blue water ribbon wrapped around the lower blade. Keep a complete readable gray blade and a simple brown grip, with no black interior, droplets, engraving, thin outlines or splashes.

One simple green fern sprig with three pairs of broad solid leaflets, releasing a single large muted-green reagent drop beneath its stem. Keep the fern compact and unmistakable; no veins, fine leaflets, glass bottle, ground or scenery.

One plain amber tavern mug with a broad handle and one small empty muted-blue speech bubble rising beside it. Use a solid cream foam cap and flat untextured mug body; no letters, faces, wood grain, bubbles or tavern scene.

One broad cream rolled bandage curved into a compact ring around a single large muted-green healing cross. Use chunky flat bandage shapes; no person, limb, blood, fabric texture, tiny perforations or additional medical tools.

One thick-rimmed ochre magnifying glass revealing a single bold violet broken-ring curse mark inside its lens. Keep the lens pale blue and the symbol broad and geometric, with no runes, letters, sparkles, reflections or extra objects.

One compact emblem of two plain broad medium-gray iron swords crossed symmetrically tip-up in a formal salute. Use simple brown grips and complete solid blades readable on a dark background; no black blade interiors, ornate guards, impact burst, blood or fighters.

One large ochre animal paw print with one broad muted-green directional arrow extending from it toward the upper right. Keep four chunky toe pads and one broad central pad; no tiny trail prints, fur, ground, compass or scenery.

One simple chestnut animal saddle with a single broad muted-blue circular switching arrow around it. Keep the saddle a clear chunky silhouette with one thick stirrup, using plain untextured leather; no animal, rider, straps, stitching, buckles or scenery.

A broad solid medium-gray sword pressing against one simplified tan forearm symbol, with a single thick dark-red diagonal injury mark at the contact point. Keep both silhouettes chunky and readable. No blood spray, gore, fingers, anatomical detail, thin blade, engraving or fragments.

A simple wooden-stock sniper rifle angled upward, with a long solid medium-gray barrel and one oversized plain tube scope. The scope and long barrel clearly distinguish it from an ordinary rifle. Smooth brown stock, no wood grain, screws, fine sights, engraving, tactical attachments or firing trail.

A single large pointed brass sniper cartridge punching through one upright broad medium-gray shield. Show one large clean gap in the shield around the cartridge, with the shield remaining one compact recognizable silhouette. No fragments, thin cracks, gun, glow, smoke, particles or decoration.

A short chunky wooden-stock double-barrel shotgun in side view with one broad solid orange fan-shaped blast directly beyond its thick muzzle. The shotgun has a short heavy barrel and no scope. The blast is one completely filled flat wedge. No separate pellets, white trail, smoke, grain, screws or scattered pixels.

A chunky double-barrel shotgun seen from a front three-quarter angle, with two large round dark muzzle openings and a short smooth brown stock. One paired firing mark made of exactly two broad solid orange wedges projects from the two barrels. No scope, tiny pellets, white trail, smoke, surface texture, screws or spark particles.
